title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the State-allocated Land Use Right of a Bankrupt Enterprise Should Be Included in the Bankruptcy Property and Other Issues

articles.content_en: I. According to the provisions of Article 58, Paragraph 1, Item (4) of the Land Administration Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 47 of the Interim Regulations on the Assignment and Transfer of the Right to Use State-owned Land in Cities and Towns, the right to use state-owned land obtained by bankrupt enterprises through allocation does not belong to bankruptcy property. Upon the bankruptcy of the enterprise, the relevant people's government may recover such land and dispose of it according to law. For state-owned enterprises included in the national merger and bankruptcy plan, their right to use state-owned land obtained according to law shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of the relevant documents of the State Council.

II. An enterprise has no right to dispose of the right to use state-owned land obtained through allocation. Where a mortgage is established with such land use right as the subject matter, in addition to going through the mortgage registration procedures according to law, approval from the people's government or the land administration department with approval authority shall also be obtained. Otherwise, the mortgage shall be deemed invalid. If the enterprise, when establishing a mortgage with the right to use state-owned land obtained through allocation, has fulfilled the statutory approval procedures and gone through mortgage registration according to law, the mortgage shall be deemed valid. According to the provisions of Article 50 of the Urban Real Estate Administration Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 56 of the Guarantee Law of the People's Republic of China, the mortgagee may enjoy the priority right of compensation only over the remaining part of the proceeds after deducting from the proceeds obtained from the conversion, auction, or sale of the mortgaged subject matter an amount equivalent to the land use rights assignment fee. However, for state-owned enterprises included in the national merger and bankruptcy plan, the establishment of a mortgage with the right to use state-owned land obtained through allocation shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of the relevant documents of the State Council.

III. The issue of the validity of a mortgage established by a state-owned enterprise on key equipment, complete sets of equipment, or factory buildings shall be handled in accordance with the Reply on the Issue of the Legal Validity of Mortgage Contracts Concluded with Creditors with Machinery and Equipment as Collateral by State-owned Industrial Enterprises (Fa Shi [2002] No. 14).
The issue of the validity of a mortgage established by a state-owned enterprise on a building shall be handled by distinguishing two cases: If the building is attached to the right to use state-owned land obtained through allocation, and the building and the land use right are mortgaged together, the mortgage on the land use right shall go through the statutory approval procedures; otherwise, the mortgage shall be deemed invalid. If the building is attached to the right to use state-owned land obtained through assignment or transfer, and the building and the land use right are mortgaged together, even if without approval from the relevant competent authority, the mortgage shall be deemed valid.
This Reply shall come into force as of the date of promulgation. It shall apply to cases being tried or not yet tried, except for cases where judgments or rulings that have already taken legal effect are subject to a retrial.
This is a reply.
